title: Filter<T>/FilterOperator<T> missing Eq derive
description: In crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs, Filter<T> and FilterOperator<T> derive PartialEq but not Eq. All concrete T types used (EmailFilterCondition, EmailSubmissionFilterCondition) are Eq. Omitting Eq means users cannot use Filter<EmailFilterCondition> as a HashMap key or in contexts requiring Eq. The derive is safe to add since PartialEq is already derived and all fields are Eq. Compare: Operator does derive Eq (line 9). Fix: add Eq to both Filter<T> and FilterOperator<T> derives.
